packageRules.description: VanillaBP itself follows the framework, not Renovate: its versions are bumped when a release is cut, and while they are snapshots there is nothing to look up.

Hazelcast decides which cluster versions this cache can join, and the README names the range it was tested against. Members of incompatible versions do not join each other, so an upgrade is part of an application's rolling-restart story and comes as a PR to look at and to carry into the README.
